chapters.title: Before the Streets
chapters.text: Before the streets, four souls woke on a blank page. The Banker counted stars. "One fee," he said. Elder Quill drew a fountain, so every tired soul could rest.

chapters.title: The First Receipt
chapters.text: Before money, the Banker printed receipts. A soul bought a promise, and a free pen. The Vampire asked, "Who pays at sunrise?" Quill kept the Banker's first receipt.

chapters.title: Words with Legs
chapters.text: One evening, spilled ink grew legs. A receipt bared its teeth, and the Mayor hid on his desk. "Write its name," said Quill. The Speedster called it homework with teeth.
